newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Finnish president sees growing ties with Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Finnish president sees growing ties with Argentina.

text.p: Finland's President Martti Ahtissari said Tuesday after a meeting with Argentine President Carlos Menem that they saw large possibilities for growth in trade between their countries.

"The economic reforms carried out by Argentina and the structure of Finland's economy generate large possibilities of exchanges in the forestry, communications and infrastructure sectors in general," Ahtissari told journalists after the meeting.
During the president's meeting Tuesday, they signed a draft agreement aimed at "reviewing all aspects of bilateral relations and exchanging points of view on international issues of mutual interest."
"This meeting reinforces the ties and contacts between our countries," Ahtissari said, adding that relations are "excellent."
President Menem also asked Ahtissari for his support for Buenos Aires' bid to host the 2004 Olympic Games, the Finnish president said.
The presidents agreed earlier in the week to strengthen trade between the two countries.

Finnish Export Credit Ltd and Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires announced Tuesday they had signed a credit line agreement of $10 million for financing exports of Finnish capital goods and related services to Argentina.
Ahtissari is accompanied by a business delegation of leading Finnish companies on his four-day visit which ends Wednesday.
